notes:
Updater test target - no functional changes.

This build exists only so a machine running 1.4.5 has a newer version to download. It proves the end-to-end in-app update: Check Now -> Download -> Install & Restart (app closes, installs silently, reopens by itself).

If you are on 1.4.5: just use the in-app updater. If you are on 1.4.4 or older, install 1.4.5 manually once first (that build contains the TLS fix).
